questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름상 적절하지 않은 것은?

I want to be a friend who gives ⓐ honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People had to ⓑ wait for him, and it made everyone ⓒ pleased. So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to ⓓ fully enjoy our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not ⓔ easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'pleased'는 '기쁜, 만족한'이라는 의미로 문맥상 맞지 않습니다. 친구가 항상 늦어서 모두를 '불쾌하게 했다'는 의미이므로 'upset'이 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone ⓐ who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both ⓑ interested in art. When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt ⓒ jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really ⓓ hardly. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was ⓔ happy about it.
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'hardly'는 '거의~하지 않는다'는 의미입니다. 문맥상 '정말 열심히 일했다'는 의미이므로 'hard'가 적절합니다.

options: 친구가 힘들어할 때 말보다는 구체적인 행동으로 위로하려 한다.
친구의 SNS 게시물을 통해서만 친구의 상태를 파악하려 한다.
친구가 좋아하는 간식보다는 재미있는 영화를 더 중요하게 생각한다.
친구가 힘든 일을 겪을 때마다 포토 부스에 함께 가자고 제안한다.
Jisu가 힘든 날을 보낸 정확한 이유를 알기 위해 노력한다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 통해 'Siyeon'의 친구 관계 방식에 대해 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happy. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.
questions.explanation: Siyeon은 친구가 힘들어할 때 말로만 위로하지 않고, 초콜릿 쿠키를 사주고, 영화를 보고, 포토부스에서 사진을 찍는 등 구체적인 행동으로 위로합니다.

options: 'B'는 Somi가 쇼핑하는 것을 돕기 위해 동행하려 한다.
'B'는 쇼핑몰 방문에 대한 구체적인 목적을 가지고 있다.
'B'는 Somi에게 자신의 일요일 쇼핑 계획에 합류할 것을 제안했다.
'B'는 버스 정류장에서 만나는 것을 Somi가 선호할 것이라 생각했다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 'B'에 대해 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: The weekend is coming. What are you planning to do, Somi?
G: I'm planning to go to the shopping mall this Sunday.
B: Oh, can I go with you? I have to buy a present for my mom.
G: Sure. What time should we meet?
B: How about meeting at 3:00 p.m. at the bus stop?
G: Sounds good. See you there.
questions.explanation: B가 "I have to buy a present for my mom."라고 말했으므로 쇼핑몰 방문에 대한 구체적인 목적(엄마선물 구매)을 가지고 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

B: Hi, Yuna. What are you doing?
G: Hi, Tom! I'm packing my bag. I'm going to go camping with my family tomorrow.
B: Oh, I see. What are you planning to do at the camping site?
G: ① My family and I are planning to have a barbecue, take a walk, and look at the stars.
B: ② Camping sites are usually very crowded and noisy on weekends. I love going camping.
G: ③ Then why don't you come with us?
B: ④ I'd love to! What time should we meet?
G: ⑤ We are planning to leave at 9:30 a.m. Can you come to my house around 9:00 a.m.?
B: Sure! See you tomorrow!
questions.explanation: "Camping sites are usually very crowded and noisy on weekends. I love going camping."은 캠핑장이 혼잡하다는 부정적 내용과 캠핑을 좋아한다는 긍정적 내용이 모순되며, 전체 대화의 흐름과 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ~ 중 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고친 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happily. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watching a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.
questions.explanation: "make her happily"는 어법상 틀렸습니다. "make + 목적어 + 형용사"의 구조이므로 "make her happy"가 올바른 표현입니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ~ 중 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고친 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People has to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be at time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." Talk to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understands.
questions.explanation: 주어가 'People'(복수)이므로 동사는 'have'를 사용해야 합니다. 'has'는 3인칭 단수일 때 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. (A)______ I knew she worked really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, (B)______ she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: (A)는 "처음에는 축하할 수 없었지만, 그녀가 정말 열심히 일했다는 것을 알았다"는 전환의 의미이므로 'But'이 적절합니다. (B)는 "축하했고, 그 결과 그녀가 행복해했다"는 순서/인과의 의미이므로 'and'가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
대화의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

주어진 문장: I can show you how to ride it.

G: Jinsu, what is your hobby?
B: I like to ride my skateboard. It's very fun. ①
G: Wow, that's cool. I want to try riding a skateboard someday. ②
B: What are you planning to do this Sunday? ③
G: I don't have any plans. Why? ④
B: I'm planning to ride my skateboard on Sunday. ⑤
G: Great! What time should we meet?
B: Let's meet at 2:00 p.m. at Central Square.
questions.explanation: G가 "스케이트보드를 타보고 싶다"고 표현한 직후 "I can show you how to ride it."이 자연스럽게 연결됩니다. 따라서 ②번 위치가 적절합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 어법상 올바른 표현끼리 짝지어진 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone (A) [who / what] is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she (B) [win / won] first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she (C) [work / worked] really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: (A) 선행사가 'someone'이므로 관계대명사는 'who'를 사용합니다. (B) 시간 표현 'When she'로 시작했으므로 과거시제 'won'이 적절합니다. (C) 마찬가지로 과거 상황이므로 'worked'가 적절합니다.

options: 독자 스스로 '좋은 친구'의 의미에 대해 생각해 볼 계기를 제공하기 위해
새 학년도에 친구를 사귀지 못했을 때의 문제점을 상세히 경고하기 위해
새 학기에 학생들이 참여할 수 있는 다양한 동아리 활동을 홍보하기 위해
학교의 모범생인 세 학생의 일상생활을 단순히 소개하기 위해
친구 관계에서 발생하는 문제들을 해결하는 유일한 방법을 제시하기 위해
questions.question:
다음 글의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

A new school year started! You can make new friends and be a good friend to others, too. What kind of friend do you want to be? Three students will tell you their stories.
questions.explanation: "What kind of friend do you want to be?"라는 질문을 제시하고 세 학생의 이야기를 통해 독자가 좋은 친구의 의미에 대해 스스로 생각해보도록 유도합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글에 나타난 강민의 성격으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. So, I decided to talk to him. "Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: Kangmin은 어려운 대화임을 알면서도 용감하게 친구와 이야기하고('courageous'), 솔직한 조언을 주려고 하며('sincere') 이를 통해 친구가 변하도록 도왔습니다.

options: Planning to do something this Saturday
Asking about the plan for the weekend
questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

G: Hi, Jiwoo. What are you planning to do this Saturday?
B: Hi, Emma. I'm planning to go to the museum.
G: (A) That sounds interesting. Can I go there with you?
B: Of course. What time should we meet?
G: Let's meet at 11:00 a.m.
questions.explanation: (A) "That sounds interesting"는 Jiwoo의 박물관 계획에 대해 긍정적으로 반응하고 함께 가기를 원하는 표현으로, 주말 계획에 대해 묻는 것과 같은 의미의 대화 흐름을 보여준다.

questions.question:
주어진 문장 다음에 이어질 대화의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Let's go to the library tomorrow, Teo. I'm planning to borrow a book.

(A) Okay. See you then.
(B) Why don't we meet at 1:00 p.m.?
(C) Sure. What time should we meet?
questions.explanation: 도서관 가자는 제안 → (C) 시간 묻기 → (B) 구체적인 시간 제안 → (A) 동의 순서가 자연스러운 대화 흐름이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Siyeon: I try to cheer up my friends ⓐ when they are having a hard time. One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her ⓑ happy. So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack. Then we watched a movie ⓒ what had a funny story and ⓓ took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she ⓔ felt better.
questions.explanation: ⓒ의 "what"은 부적절하다. "watched a movie that had a funny story"로 관계대명사 "that"을 사용해야 한다. "what"은 관계대명사로 이 문맥에서 사용될 수 없다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 ① ② ③ ④ ⑤ 중 흐름상 어색한 문장은?

I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. ① People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. ② So, I decided to talk to him. ③ "Can you please be on time?" I said. ④ "We want to fully enjoy our time together." ⑤ However, sometimes telling a white lie is necessary to protect a friend's feelings. Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!
questions.explanation: ⑤의 "However, sometimes telling a white lie is necessary to protect a friend's feelings"는 정직한 조언을 주는 친구가 되고 싶다는 주제와 모순된다. 이 문장은 흐름을 방해한다.

options: I need to return a book to the library
I have to buy a present for my mom
I want to ride my skateboard there
I am planning to go camping alone
I have to stay home and study math
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: The weekend is coming. What are you planning to do, Somi?
G: I'm planning to go to the shopping mall this Sunday.
B: Oh, can I go with you? ____________________.
G: Sure. What time should we meet?
B: How about meeting at 3:00 p.m. at the bus stop?
G: Sounds good. See you there.
questions.explanation: B가 G와 함께 쇼핑몰에 가고 싶어 하는 이유를 제시해야 한다. "I have to buy a present for my mom"이 함께 가는 동기로 가장 자연스럽다.

options: 소녀는 스케이트보드를 타는 것에 흥미를 보이고 있다.
진수는 이번 주 일요일에 스케이트보드를 탈 계획이다.
소녀는 진수에게 스케이트보드 타는 법을 가르쳐 주기로 했다.
두 사람은 일요일 오후 2시에 만나기로 약속했다.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

G: Jinsu, what is your hobby?
B: I like to ride my skateboard. It's very fun.
G: Wow, that's cool. I want to try riding a skateboard someday.
B: What are you planning to do this Sunday?
G: I don't have any plans. Why?
B: I'm planning to ride my skateboard on Sunday. I can teach you.
G: Great! What time should we meet?
B: Let's meet at 2:00 p.m. at Central Square.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 진수가 소녀에게 스케이트보드 타는 법을 가르쳐주기로 한 것이지, 소녀가 진수에게 가르치기로 한 것이 아니다. 따라서 ③이 부정확하다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 7번째에 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Kangmin: I want to be a friend who gives honest advice. One of my friends was always late. People had to wait for him, and it made everyone upset. So, I decided to talk to him.

"Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." (A) 이 문제에 대해 내 친구에게 이야기하는 것은 쉽지 않았다. But thankfully, he understood. Now he is always on time!

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (형태 변형 없음)
- 단어: problem / easy / not / about / to / my / talking / was / this / friend
questions.explanation: 정렬 순서: Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. 7번째 단어는 "problem"이다.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

But I knew she worked really hard.

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. ( ① ) Minji and I are both interested in art. ( ② ) When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. ( ③ ) I couldn't congratulate her at first. ( ④ ) Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about it. ( ⑤ )
questions.explanation: "But I knew she worked really hard"는 질투심을 극복하기 직전에 오는 것이 자연스럽다. "I couldn't congratulate her at first"와 "Finally, I congratulated her" 사이에 오는 ④가 가장 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

I try to cheer up my friends when they are having a hard time.

(A) So, I bought her chocolate cookies, her favorite snack.
(B) One day, Jisu posted, "It was a hard day," on her social media. I wanted to do something to make her happy.
(C) Then we watched a movie that had a funny story and took pictures together at a photo booth. We had a great time, and she said she felt better.
questions.explanation: 자연스러운 이야기 흐름: 친구를 격려하려는 노력 → (B) 구체적인 상황 설명 → (A) 행동 → (C) 결과 및 마무리

questions.question:
다음 대화의 (A), (B), (C)에 어법상 올바른 표현끼리 짝지어진 것은?

G: Hi, Jiwoo. What are you planning (A) [to do / doing] this Saturday?
B: Hi, Emma. I'm planning to go to the museum.
G: That sounds (B) [interest / interesting]. Can I go there with you?
B: Of course. What time should we meet?
G: Let's (C) [meet / meeting] at 11:00 a.m.
questions.explanation: (A) "planning to do" - 부정사 사용, (B) "sounds interesting" - 형용사 필요, (C) "Let's meet" - 동사원형 사용

options: Bora는 Minji의 수상 소식에 처음부터 진심으로 기뻐했다.
Bora는 친구의 노력을 인정하며 자신의 질투심을 극복했다.
Bora는 Minji와의 경쟁 때문에 미술에 대한 흥미를 잃었다.
Bora는 Minji가 1등 상을 받을 만큼 열심히 노력하지 않았다고 생각했다.
Bora는 Minji를 축하한 이후에도 계속해서 질투심을 느꼈다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 통해 'Bora'에 관해 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bora: I want to be someone who is happy about my friends' good news. Minji and I are both interested in art. When she won first prize in the school's art competition, I felt jealous. I couldn't congratulate her at first. But I knew she worked really hard. Finally, I congratulated her, and she was happy about it.
questions.explanation: Bora는 처음에 질투를 느껴 축하할 수 없었지만, Minji가 열심히 노력했음을 인식하고 결국 진심으로 축하했다. 이는 친구의 노력을 인정하고 질투심을 극복한 것을 보여준다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 6번째에 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? (단, 콤마(,)는 단어 순서에 포함하지 않음)

A new school year started! (A) 너는 새 친구들을 사귀고 다른 사람들에게 좋은 친구가 될 수도 있다. What kind of friend do you want to be? Three students will tell you their stories.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (형태 변형 없음)
- 단어: friends / can / others / good / new / make / friend / and / be / a / you / to / , / too
questions.explanation: 정렬 순서: You can make new friends, and be a good friend to others too. 6번째 단어는 "and"이다.

options: he has fixed his habit of being late
he does not meet us anymore
he claims that being late is his style
he forces others to wait for him
he has troubling managing his time
questions.question:

"Can you please be on time?" I said. "We want to fully enjoy our time together." Talking to my friend about this problem was not easy. But thankfully, he understood. Now __________________________________!
questions.explanation: 앞의 내용에서 친구가 늦는 습관을 고치도록 조언했고 "he understood"라고 했으므로, 그 결과로 "he has fixed his habit of being late" (그는 늦는 습관을 고쳤다)가 가장 적절하다.
